symptom: Bound directory capability src/ authorizes target src/a.py, yet physical Director write fails as out-of-scope; no effect receipt reaches ToolBatchRuntime.

dynamic_evidence.debugger: pytest --pdb at failing physical receipt assertion

root_cause: Physical adapter bound capability scope directly into exact-file WriteGate act.files. Directory capability and current exact effect target are distinct contracts.

fix.scope_narrowing: Validate immutable target against canonical same-Cell capability matcher; physical executor permits only that exact target, with original scope retained for dependency checks.
fix.no_file_effect: Command/no-file-state does not fabricate a file target.

residual_risk: Control-plane claim/physical receipt proof is local integrated evidence, not fresh end-to-end runnable qualification.
